hints.title: Preserve All Flights
hints.text: Use a left join from Flights to Passengers so flights without passengers are included with 0 bookings.

hints.title: Aggregation by Flight
hints.text: Count the number of passengers per flight id.

hints.title: Capacity Partitioning
hints.text: Booked count is bounded above by capacity, while waitlist count is any excess above capacity.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    f.flight_id, 
    LEAST(f.capacity, COUNT(p.passenger_id)) AS booked_cnt,
    GREATEST(0, COUNT(p.passenger_id) - f.capacity) AS waitlist_cnt
FROM Flights f
LEFT JOIN Passengers p ON f.flight_id = p.flight_id
GROUP BY f.flight_id, f.capacity
ORDER BY f.flight_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Left join between Flights and Passengers with capacity bounding.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: An inner join discards flights that currently have zero passenger registrations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(f log f + p) time dominated by the join, grouping, and ordering of flights.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use LEAST and GREATEST or CASE statements to divide bookings cleanly against capacity.

import pandas as pd

def flight_occupancy_and_waitlist(flights: pd.DataFrame, passengers: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    counts = passengers.groupby("flight_id").size().reset_index(name="total")
    df = flights.merge(counts, on="flight_id", how="left").fillna({"total": 0})
    df["total"] = df["total"].astype(int)
    df["booked_cnt"] = df[["capacity", "total"]].min(axis=1)
    df["waitlist_cnt"] = (df["total"] - df["capacity"]).clip(lower=0)
    return df[["flight_id", "booked_cnt", "waitlist_cnt"]].sort_values("flight_id")
